name: header-editorial
title: Editorial header
author: Lambda Curry <https://github.com/lambda-curry>
description: A magazine masthead: a centered wordmark with tagline, a top line for an issue or place, and section links between double rules that wrap instead of hiding.

meta.useWhen: The site publishes writing or has distinct sections, and the name deserves to be the loudest thing at the top.
meta.avoidWhen: The site needs a primary action in the header more than a wordmark, or the name is long. Use header-floating or header-minimal.
